A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Disco-RAG and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices. Content can be reliably matched across the revisions and relocations.

before.justification: V1 reports original benchmark experiments, ablations, robustness tests, parser evaluations, and human assessments, including additional empirical analyses in its appendices.

after.justification: V4 retains these original empirical results and adds a mixed-model deployment experiment on Loong.

M1.justification: The retrieval, intra-chunk RST parsing, inter-chunk graph construction, planning, and generation procedure is retained. The new mixed-model experiment assigns different models to existing modules. Appendix prompt edits are limited wording refinements.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate long-context reasoning on Loong, ambiguous question answering on ASQA, scientific summarization on SciNews, and discourse parsing on RST-DT. The mixed-model experiment uses existing Loong coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding benchmark, parser, planning, and shallow-discourse comparisons. RAS remains the same comparator despite its citation changing from a 2025 preprint to a 2026 publication.

E3.justification: V4 adds a Loong configuration using Llama-3.1-8B for parsing, graph construction, and planning, with Llama-3.3-70B for generation (Table 5). Existing benchmark metrics, 256-token chunking, Top-10 retrieval, and beam width 3 remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The new mixed-model analysis tests whether smaller structural models preserve the benefits of a larger generator. Existing ablation, robustness, parser, efficiency, attention, and case analyses remain. The fine-tuning study moves from v1 Appendix G to v4 Section 5 rather than being newly introduced.

E5.justification: Both versions state that each setting runs once, measure annotator agreement with Fleiss' kappa, and report paired t-tests with p < 0.05 (v1 Appendix H; v4 Appendix F). Agreement-value corrections and rounding do not introduce a new statistical procedure.

E6.justification: New Table 5 reports 60.52 LLM Score and 0.22 EM for the 8B+70B configuration. Local corrections include Qwen2.5-72B's Set 1 overall scores changing from 69.59/0.36 to 69.39/0.33 in Table 1, retrieve-and-plan overall EM changing from 0.14 to 0.18 in Table 4, and human relevance agreement changing from 0.72 to 0.73. Most results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 3 retains the same conditional-generation equations and RST/graph formalizations. The appendix metric definitions are also unchanged, with no added or revised proofs or formal assumptions.

C1.justification: The main discourse-aware RAG contributions remain. The introduction revises Loong's claimed gain from 'up to 10.0' to an overall 12.74 points and changes the ASQA superiority claim from EM and DR Score to EM and ROUGE-L, consistent with the retained tables.

C2.justification: V4 adds an interpretation of mixed-model deployment as a tradeoff between structural-model capacity and resource requirements. It removes explicit discussion of untested dialogue/agent applications and alternative discourse formalisms from the Scope and Generalization limitation. Parser evaluation and discussion of unavailable gold annotations remain in the appendix.

D1.justification: V4 adds a project-information link and specifies the mixed-model module assignments. It removes v1's dataset appendix and statistics table, including test counts and languages, and deletes the explicit corpus-wide versus source-document retrieval descriptions. These omissions do not establish changes to the underlying datasets or retrieval settings.

R1.justification: V4 adds citations including SciRAG, GRO-RAG, ARK, and additional evaluation-related works, while removing T-RAG and Zhang et al.'s hierarchical RAG reference. The central positioning of rhetorical structure relative to existing structure-aware RAG remains unchanged.

P1.justification: V4 merges Results and Analysis, moves the fine-tuning subsection into the main text, removes the dataset appendix and two limitation subsections, and adds acknowledgements. Author information and wording receive limited edits; most prose is retained.

P2.justification: V4 adds the mixed-model table, removes the dataset-statistics table, and relocates the fine-tuning table from the appendix to the main text. Other tables are renumbered or reflowed, while the existing pipeline figures, plots, cases, and prompt displays largely retain their designs.

improvement.justification: V4 adds useful evidence for mixed-model deployment: the 8B+70B configuration achieves 60.52 versus 62.07 for all-70B. It also corrects ASQA and SciNews superiority summaries that conflicted with the retained tables. These provide a limited overall improvement in evidence and claim accuracy, partly offset by removing dataset statistics, retrieval-scope details, and explicit applicability qualifications.
